subject: Rebaseline: Nimbus Health evaluation runway & contingency plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@nimbushealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to rebaseline eval runway

Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We started the internal eval but knocked into two blockers: procurement needs an approved cost breakdown for the Dedicated option, and our security lead asked for a clarified SOC2 evidence timeline. Both are gating our procurement approval; as a result we need to shift the pilot start by ~2 weeks.

Can we rebaseline the MAP? High level ask: extend close target from Oct 8 to Oct 22, and add a contingency lane (parallel canary on subset) so we don't block customer acceptance testing. Happy to hop on a 30-min call.

—Liam
Nimbus Health

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to rebaseline eval runway

Liam — thanks for the heads up and the clear ask.

Short answer: yes, we can rebaseline. I attached a proposed MAP_v2 that shows the shifted milestones plus a parallel canary lane and pre-approved fallback (hosted short-term) if Dedicated PO slips further.

Quick notes:
- Procurement copy: Ben will send the cost breakdown and an accelerated invoice option to help procurement approve the PO sooner.
- Security: Marissa will confirm SOC2 evidence delivery dates and provide the minimal artifact set required for your security review.
- Contingency: propose we keep the original Oct 8 milestone as a "soft target" for feature validation on hosted, while Oct 22 becomes committed close for Dedicated.

Propose a quick alignment call tomorrow (Sep 16) 10–10:30 PT to walk the MAP_v2. Do either of those work for you?

Thanks,
Priya
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to rebaseline eval runway

Looping in a quick update from security side for the MAP and risk log:

We can get the bulk of the SOC2 artifacts (system descriptions, control mappings, SRM export) to Nimbus by Sep 20. A handful of items (internal change logs for a specific connector) may take until Sep 27 — those are non-blocking for an initial security sign-off if Nimbus accepts a staged evidence plan.

I'll add a short "evidence staging" section to the MAP_v2 and include acceptance criteria for staged sign-off. Also recommend a 1-week buffer after security sign-off before PO submission to allow procurement cycles.

—Marissa
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: MAP risk register + cost appendix

Attached: Nimbus_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, risk register)
Attached: cost_breakdown_nimbus.pdf (Dedicated vs Hosted options, invoice cadence)

Risk summary (top 3):
1) Procurement cycle compression — medium risk. Mitigation: pre-authorized invoice option, legal quick-accept template.
2) Security evidence gaps — medium-high. Mitigation: staged evidence plan + security acceptance criteria.
3) Integration test flakiness — low. Mitigation: parallel canary + reduced scope for initial validation.

I put two proposed rebaseline dates in the MAP: Oct 22 (preferred committed close) and Oct 29 (conservative). Please confirm which you want to commit to; we'll lock the MAP and notify legal/procurement teams.

—Ben
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-09-22T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Rebaseline confirmed: Oct 22 committed, Oct 8 soft target

Liam — following our call today, confirming what we agreed: 
- Committed close (Dedicated PO + pilot kickoff): Oct 22, 2027.
- Soft target for hosted feature validation: Oct 8, 2027.
- Security staging: major artifacts by Sep 20; remaining connector logs by Sep 27 (Marissa will share the evidence bundle).
- Procurement: Ben will submit cost breakdown and pre-authorized invoice by Sep 17 to accelerate PO.
- Contingency lane: parallel canary on hosted (subset of traffic) to validate critical flows if Dedicated is delayed.

Action items (owners):
- Ben: cost appendix + legal quick-accept template (Due: Sep 17)
- Marissa: evidence bundle + staged acceptance criteria (Due: Sep 20)
- Priya: update MAP_v2 in Drive and send to Nimbus with revised dates + link to HubSpot deal (Done: Sep 22)

I'll update the HubSpot milestone and flag the deal with the new close date and the contingency lane. If anything slips, we'll escalate to the AE director and head of customer success.

Thanks all — Priya
